label: For "Real-Time Service Activation Agent": Take a validated order for a new feature, add-on or business service and drive it through eligibility, provisioning and verification in minutes, escalating only the exceptions to people. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Retrying without idempotency.
